# @sharadox/animation-web-library

> React animations (Motion-based where needed); reduced motion respected.

- /reveal: <Reveal delay y=24 blur=6 margin="-12% 0px" className>children</Reveal>
- /scroll-word: <ScrollWords text className offset=["start 80%","end 40%"] opacity=[0.12,1] span=1.5 />
- /in-view: useInView<T>(threshold=0.35) → [ref, inView]
- /count-up: useCountUp(target, start, durationMs=1600) → number
- /marquee: useMarquee<T>({ speed=40 }) → ref for a track with two identical groups; drag + fling; horizontal wheel or Shift + wheel scrolls it (vertical wheel left to the page); no auto-motion with reduced motion
- Peer: react. License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
- Reveal and useCountUp show their final state when mounted during a soft navigation (web-library isSoftNavigation, e.g. a language switch)
